newsitem.title: USA: Toshiba starts U.S. shipments of DVD.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba starts U.S. shipments of DVD.

text.p: Toshiba America Consumer Products Inc, a unit of Japan's Toshiba Corp, said on Tuesday it has begun shipping its first two DVD (digital video disc) movie players.
The company said the Model SD-2006 and the Model SD-3006, with respective manufacturer suggested prices of $599 and $699, will be available on store shelves this month.

Toshiba said its most aggressive marketing activities will be concentrated in the seven cities initially targeted for software availability -- New York, Chicago, Dallas, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Seattle and Washington D.C.
The company said it is using instore promotional materials and a multi-million dollar TV, radio, and print advertising campaign to lure shoppers.

Toshiba has entered several marketing alliances, including one with Time Warner Inc, to promote DVD products and software, it said. Toshiba and Time Warner had an alliance for an industry standard while developing the DVD.
Toshiba is offering "bonus checks" for additional merchandise through March and April on DVD, direct satellite or home theater audio systems with the purchase of a large screen television, it said.
